# Trace ADMIN service dependencies (a SEPARATE service from trace-server).
#
# Flask          — web framework; bundles Werkzeug, which provides the password
#                  hashing (generate/check_password_hash) and signed sessions
#                  the admin auth relies on. No extra auth library needed.
# gunicorn       — production WSGI server used in the container image.
# psycopg2-binary — Postgres driver; the admin shares the game's dedicated
#                  Postgres by importing trace-server/db.py.

Flask>=3.0,<4.0
gunicorn>=21.2,<23.0
psycopg2-binary>=2.9,<3.0
